title: Charter Space raises $5M to bring insurance to the stars
snippet: As Charter explains on its website, a common experience for space companies is that regular insurers "heard a bunch of scary science words and freaked out."

title: Tinder adapts to a social, IRL dating future with ‘Group Hangouts’ feature
